metaDescription: Japanese Chin vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Japanese Chin boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Japanese Chin social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Japanese Chin exposure.
Weight range 4-9 lb (1.8-4 kg) and grooming needs (Soft coat brushing; face cleaning.) belong in the same Japanese Chin household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.
If your Japanese Chin is also monitored for patellar luxation, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Japanese Chin appointments.
After the Japanese Chin puppy/kitten series, keep adult DA2PP / DHPP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: If your Japanese Chin misses the dose scheduled near week 12, call the clinic the same day with product names — do not restart the Japanese Chin series from memory.
The danger for a delayed Japanese Chin is the gap, not the embarrassment, because parvovirus pressure stays real for an under-vaccinated puppy even in clean-looking neighborhoods.
While waiting for the make-up DA2PP / DHPP visit, skip high-traffic dog parks / unknown-cat intros and keep the Japanese Chin away from unvaccinated animals.
After catch-up, rewrite reminders for the next Japanese Chin due date (7, 3, and 1 day prior) so the same miss does not recur.

faqs.question: When does the Japanese Chin core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Japanese Chin misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Japanese Chin health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Japanese Chin adult health guide for breed predispositions such as heart disease screening needs, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
